name: Nayu-chan no Yuuutsu
original_name: 奈夕ちゃんのユウウツ
source:
Main character is a psychiatrist, and Nayu-chan is his assistant. They use new mental extension device SECOM at treatment sessions. With its help they listen to girls troubles and lift mental suffering. However, there is a suspicious organization that aims at SECOM device. Will protagonist protect Nayu-chan and SECOM while solving patients' problems?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名精神科医生，娜由是他的助手。他们在治疗时使用新型精神扩展装置SECOM。借助它，他们倾听女孩们的烦恼，减轻精神痛苦。然而，一个可疑组织盯上了SECOM装置。主角能在解决患者问题的同时保护娜由和SECOM吗？

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
